add.label: THR at least one month of Take Home Pay, prorated below 12 months of service
add.label_id: THR paling sedikit 1 kali Take Home Pay

fields.name: expression
fields.value: max(income('thr'), (round((base_salary + fixed_allowance + income('tunjangan_grade')) * min(hr('months_of_service'), 12) / 12, 1, 'down') if hr('months_of_service') >= 1 and hr('unpaid_leave_months') < 10 and hr('days_terminated_before_holiday') <= 30 and hr('terminated_at_own_request') != 1 else 0))

source.quote: Besarnya THR bagi Pegawai yang telah mempunyai masa kerja 12 (dua belas) bulan terus-menerus atau lebih, paling sedikit 1 (satu) kali Take Home Pay
diberikan secara proporsional sesuai masa kerjanya, dihitung dengan rumus
THR tidak diberikan apabila Pegawai sedang menjalani cuti di luar tanggungan Perusahaan minimal selama 10 (sepuluh) bulan terus–menerus
Take Home Pay adalah pendapatan yang diterima setiap bulan yang terdiri dari Fixed Pay dan Tunjangan Grade

source.provision: Keputusan Dirjen PHI dan Jamsos, Diktum KEDUA
source.quote: mulai berlaku terhitung tanggal 01 Maret 2025 s.d. 31 Desember 2026

llm.note: Fixed Pay is read as base_salary + fixed_allowance and Tunjangan Grade (income 'tunjangan_grade') as regular non-fixed income outside the BPJS base; the exception for Jasa Produksi and Insentif Hasil Lebih (tax borne by the employee) is not modelled as a separate rule because no case carries these components, so such pay is entered as bonus/other irregular income. The UMP floor of the BPJS base is not modelled, and Pasal 22 ayat (3) concerns corporate tax incentives per its Penjelasan, so it has no PPh 21 effect.

output.reason: The PKB sets payroll rules that change the PPh 21 computation for WIKA's permanent employees. Income tax on employee pay is borne by the company, except for Jasa Produksi and Insentif Hasil Lebih. Government tax incentives are not passed on to employees. The BPJS Ketenagakerjaan contribution base is the last Fixed Pay, with a floor at the DKI Jakarta UMP. Tunjangan Grade is excluded from the BPJS base.
